title: Presentations: tell the story of the decision, not the list of technologies

videos.script: Lívia has ten minutes with the CEO, the finance director and the head of product. Her first draft had seven slides. {{title}} Current architecture. Connection limits. Replication modes. Every slide was accurate, and the word checkout first appeared on slide five. {{draft}} Nobody approves a method. They approve an outcome at a price. {{rewrite}} So this lesson turns the presentation into the story of a decision. How things are. What changed. What should be done. {{arc}} Each slide makes one claim, and says it in its title. {{slide}} Then the part that decides most meetings: the questions afterwards, and the conversations before the meeting even starts.
